body:
# Overnight art batch: 4 October 2026

Owner: Codex art, thread `01a10869-af91-7490-9f19-c99e0842fcc1`, mailbox actor codex with ART subject prefix. Task `ART-OVERNIGHT-20261004`. State IN_PROGRESS.

Exact initial exclusive writes: this report; `assets/expeditions/production/9fo/v2/overnight-art-20261004/` (runtime copies, isolated QA and local manifest); `scripts/dev/qa-orchard-art-overnight-20261004.cjs`. Existing assets, source manifests, engine, generation, UI and shared outputs remain read-only. Renderer/global art claim depends on explicit legacy release, never inferred from time or shared actor.

Read master brief, AGENTS, implementation/generation specifications, delivery board, overnight handoff, art request/station handoff, pipeline, visual acceptance and owner reports. Dirty checkout preserved. Legacy TURNING-RAVINE and final-build remain active at initial claim.

Initial pixel evidence inspected: actual Turning Ravine tablet native and phone maximum browser screenshots dated 4 October, plus existing station identities-green contact. Ravine shows generic control/calibration/joint/stabiliser glyphs. Approved station silhouettes are distinct and available. Existing prepared Crosswind states exist; no genuinely missing bitmap is established, so no image generation is justified. Reuse, exact-hash QA and isolated compositions proceed while legacy claim is active.

Next: record selected hashes/bytes/alpha/bounds/anchors and inspect four backgrounds, small/native/zoom compositions. These compositions are asset evidence, not live App/device/child acceptance. Publish actionable resolver gaps and stable art inputs through local mailbox before/after batch. No shared full build.

## Stable independent batch delivered

17 exact-byte copies: seven painted station/socket identities, six existing code-native badges and four Crosswind states. Total 408,700 bytes. Local manifest: `assets/expeditions/production/9fo/v2/overnight-art-20261004/manifest.json`. Each record retains source path/hash, original runtime path, bytes/SHA-256, alpha diagnostics, bounds, ground anchor, safe areas and QA paths. Originals and global registries unchanged. No new image generation or image editing.

Reproduction: `node scripts/dev/qa-orchard-art-overnight-20261004.cjs`. Exact source byte/hash gates all pass; generated four-background per-asset PNGs, four contact sheets, 48/96/192/384 sheets and `.45/1/2` one-hex prop compositions. Font-cache warnings did not prevent output. Inspected all four contact backgrounds, full prop zoom composition and Crosswind idle/hit/defeated and working-cue scale sheets. No visible matte/checkerboard/clipping found. Alpha validator separately passes selected wind stabiliser, Crosswind idle and defeat. Seven painted props have zero detached pixels except socket's previously documented one pixel. Crosswind leaf/swirl islands are intentional: idle 952, telegraph 2163, hit 16933, defeat259 detached pixels; diagnostics preserved, no threshold changed or pixels removed. Hit/telegraph are staged, not requests to expand production state handling without actual events.

Props fit uniformly within one logical hex using existing `fitSpriteInHex`. Their full metadata ground anchor remains [192,330]; live prop fitting uses silhouette centre as existing contract, rather than treating the source ground point as tile hit geometry. Figures retain existing standing placement. At `.45` overview, fine fittings and badges need selected detail/live labels; native silhouettes are distinct. Badge geometry belongs in code; enlarged raster cue previews expose low resolution, so coding should prefer native SVG controls for scalable overlays when authorised.

Ravine mapping proposed: control -> existing ledger console; number/calibration -> power bus cabinet, keeping battlefield equation frame separate; shape/turning joint -> triangular brace; sustain -> two-sail wind stabiliser; alcove -> sheltered brace nook. Additional painted input over existing Four Locks selected station kit is only wind stabiliser 30,762 bytes. Preserve immutable provisional blueprint artIds and map family/entity in resolver. Control valid/corrupted, independent ready/held/damaged, and prepared/held alcove predicates stay production `stationPresentation` semantics. No independent alcove or control charge store.

Actual new legacy screenshots inspected read-only: Crosswind focused maximum, tablet native, phone native and desktop overview dated4October. Crosswind illustrated sprite is now visible in focused maximum and overview; original Cr placeholder gap is resolved by legacy import. The focus drawer covers much of its sprite, a coding/UI placement concern. Ravine stations remain generic glyphs. Opening native views put Crosswind offscreen and use Find cue: no evidence of missing art from those views. Furrow remains forward-facing with grounded feet. These are actual browser screenshot evidence produced by legacy worker, not screenshots produced by this isolated script or physical device tests.

Ready integration dependency: after explicit legacy release, claim renderer/station import manifest/test boundaries, add the wind stabiliser and family/entity mapping, then hand stable inputs to Claude for shared build. Coding owns MapViewport and drawer positioning. Current ownership check still shows TURNING-RAVINE and final-build active; no global edits or shared build attempted. Final station live min/native/max/state stacking, physical device and child acceptance remain unverified.

## Released-file integration claim

Legacy explicit mailbox release `1791142879019-ff6051e8693c` received; locks confirm TURNING-RAVINE/final-build released. Claim ART-RAVINE-INTEGRATION-20261004 exact writes: `expeditions/v2/art/renderer.js`, `station-art.js`, `station-manifest.json`, `station-art.test.js`, `scripts/dev/embed-orchard-station-art.cjs` and this report. Add existing wind asset and Ravine family/entity resolver. No UI/engine/generation/App/build writes. EquationWheel remains unchanged.

## Integration completed: stable inputs for final-build owner

State proposed REVIEW for this scoped batch. `orchardStationFor` now consumes explicit family/entity mappings from the selected station manifest. All five Ravine station identities return illustrated sprites through the existing placement/cue interface. Four Locks maps identically; unknown families continue returning null. Wind stabiliser selected by exact original hash; original station batch and blueprint/certificate data unchanged. No new backgrounds, figures, glyph bitmaps or geometry.

`node scripts/dev/embed-orchard-station-art.cjs`: verifies13 batch assets, selects11, selected station bytes211010, combined selected art2556252 (below12MiB). Additional selected bytes30762. `node --test expeditions/v2/art/station-art.test.js expeditions/v2/art/art.test.js`:9/9passed. Tests cover exact embedded hashes/bytes, family lookup, independent objective tree, unchanged historical winning replay, stacked ready/held/damaged and separate alcove/control semantics, hero ground anchors and Crosswind identity. Dynamic combined budget retained rather than an outdated magic byte total.

Changed production files: renderer.js, station-art.js and station-manifest.json; preparation selector and station tests in claimed paths. Global sprite manifest/runtime-art and EquationWheel untouched. All art inputs stable for Claude's final-build. This art worker did not run full build or modify either HTML output. Newly wired Ravine stations need refreshed actual browser screenshots through final-build/private preview owner; prior live screenshots remain historical pre-integration evidence. Live state/zoom approval, physical device and child acceptance remain open.

Next ready work: Codex coding can consume existing orchardArtFor interface without changes and inspect on-map state cues. Claude can build stable art alongside stable coding inputs. No bitmap deficiency currently justifies imagegen. Further family mapping waits concrete generated packets and ready engine semantics; no premature family activation.

## Next claim: painted UI frames and original portraits

Sam's latest full-Orchard priority received. ART-FRAMES-20261004 owns new `assets/expeditions/production/9fo/v2/ui-frame-batch-20261004/`, `scripts/dev/prepare-orchard-ui-frames-20261004.cjs`, new `expeditions/v2/art/ui-kit.js`, `ui-kit.json` and this report. Coding exclusively owns UI clipping/layout/CSS. Existing original `wm-9fo-card-art.js`, frame/button sources and scene-kit remain read-only.

Actual legacy Crosswind phone/tablet/desktop frames inspected: current heroFrame is a wide rectangular nameplate with no circular portrait aperture. Tiny battlefield sprite overlays its text area. Current action source has a real left circular slot and separate right text panel, but CSS stretches it and paints an opaque rectangle over the panel; '?' help buttons inherit the full painted action background. Abilities use plain gradients. Existing original `NFO_CHARACTER_ART` is available via App avatarForCard and must replace battlefield pose portraits in team controls. Existing contextual button frame provides the missing circular/text geometry without new illustration. Selected/pressed/focused/spent/disabled painted variants exist, subject to alpha and size review.

## Painted frame package stable

`art/ui-kit.js` exports ORCHARD_UI_KIT (team, available, selected, pressed, focused, disabled, spent, danger, confirm, panel) and ORCHARD_UI_GEOMETRY. Metadata: `art/ui-kit.json` and exclusive batch manifest. Nine selected painted bitmaps218010bytes, one withheld silver disabled candidate16512bytes. All nine selected assets pass unchanged alpha validator. Source originals retained. Common button crop removes visible unrelated right-edge strips; all state silhouettes remain aligned and intact. Small diagnostic detached pixels remain recorded (0–4), visually imperceptible in four backgrounds. Disabled silver triggers7070neutral-light-pixel heuristic; staged, not imported. Export disabled aliases available; code applies grayscale to decoration only, retains clear unavailable text and actual disabled/aria-disabled semantics. No validator bypass, source-image painting or generation.

Team asset512×171: portraitCircle [148.5,85.3,39], textSafeArea [214,62,176,54] in source pixels. Width/height and array fields directly match coding PartyMember consumer. Recommended360×120, minimum300×100 with exact source aspect512/171. Circle portrait and text are separate DOM layers; wrap long names to2lines and keep a separate support line. Never stretch the frame or overlay a battlefield sprite on text. QA team-300/360/420 PNGs show original Furrow, Harvestmoon and The Tenth Scarecrow; original circular gallery covers30characters. Default object-position50%38%, tall-head Cornix/Millrace/Longshadow need top-biased live crop review. Coding received contract and actionable mobile readability note.

Action variants360×192: iconCircle [92,96,53], textSafeArea [170,64,139,71]. Recommended240×128,min216×115.2. Glyphs, labels/costs and state explanations remain code. Panel512×256: textSafeArea [80,65,352,131] for help/ability/result composition. Informational '?' controls need a compact painted circular treatment, not full action-frame inheritance. Selected/focused strokes plus live aria-pressed/focus remain independent of spent/unavailable semantics.

Original portrait source is App's existing `wm-9fo-card-art.js:NFO_CHARACTER_ART` via avatarForCard. Exact bytes for all30characters copied to QA-only portrait-references (525590bytes), hashes/dimensions recorded. No second runtime portrait import. Source original PNG examples Furrow/Tenth Scarecrow inspected. All30circle gallery inspected. Four-background frame/state contacts and team responsive compositions inspected; no visible matte/checkerboard. Font-cache warnings did not prevent QA. SVG QA initially failed to show WebP embedded image layers; corrected by PNG decoding solely for QA rendering and re-inspected resulting complete composition. This is isolated composition evidence, not browser/child/device acceptance.

Reproduction: `node scripts/dev/prepare-orchard-ui-frames-20261004.cjs`. Exact byte/hash/QA-path validation independently confirms all10records,218010selectedbytes. Stable production exports ready for coding; current live screenshot refresh remains coding/final-build dependency. No full build or UI edits by art.
